subject: prototypes/m0-flight-readiness-review

clarity.notes: The first screen answers its question without leaving the page: stored analysis_use, separately labelled derived post_analysis_eligibility with its derivation rule, one sentence naming the exact check that limits the Flight, and the typed next safe action with its reopen condition. Every value is traceable to a packet field. Held at 4 rather than 5 because a blocked packet still presents eighteen consequential rows that all restate one cause (CHK-16), so the reader does more scanning than the finding requires.

hierarchy.notes: Decision, then why it is limited, then next safe action, then the exact proof, then the ordered material checks. Two ordering defects found by reading the first render were fixed: the source-read and D4/D6 receipts had been placed after a nineteen-row table, and the Gaps route had buried its own supersession answer beneath twenty gap rows. Held at 4 because the Boundaries route leaves a wide unused right column at desktop width, where the provenance table could sit beside the list.

typography.notes: One sans and one mono, used as a register rather than as decoration: every identifier, digest, timestamp, locator, receipt id, rule source and enum is monospace, and every sentence is sans. No serif on a dashboard, no Inter, no gradient headline, no oversized H1 — the decision value carries weight at 21px rather than scale. Uppercase is confined to 9.5px mono micro-labels, matching the owner-selected reference, and never used for running text. Measures are bounded at 68 to 82ch.

motion.notes: Deliberately static. The stylesheet contains no keyframe, no transition, no transform and no animation of any kind, and prefers-reduced-motion is honoured regardless. Interaction feedback is a tone change on hover, focus and :active rather than movement, which suits a read-only forensic workspace and means nothing on the page can distract from an evidence value. Scored 5 for fitness to purpose, not for quantity of motion.

brand.notes: The owner-selected language is carried faithfully: dark identity block against a light forensic workspace, rail plus route nav plus workspace plus inspector, 1px rules instead of elevation, orange for selection and blocked state, green for validated. Two colour-discipline defects were fixed: every typed absence had been rendered in the warn colour until orange stopped meaning anything, and the receipt-reach callout used an orange wash that read as an alarm on a decision_grade screen. Held at 4 because a fourth semantic colour (amber for MISSING and UNKNOWN) exceeds the one-accent guidance; it is kept because collapsing those states into pass-green or block-orange would misreport a typed outcome.

iteration_notes: Pass 1 rendered the surface and read the captures against the owner-selected design contract; eight defects (D1 to D8) were found and fixed.

Pass 2 re-read the required design skills, found and fixed four further issues (orange spent on absence, orange on a non-blocked callout, an inset shadow standing in for a rule, short enums breaking mid-word), and added :active feedback.
boundary: This panel scores a local fixture-only prototype. It establishes no production capability, no production authorization, no P3 closure and no Experiment Review Committee decision.
